payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear methodology for determining knowledge dimensions based on crowd worker judgments and agreement levels.

claims.text: Knowledge dimensions are determined by collecting human judgments on frame knowledge implications and comparing object pairs along these dimensions.
Crowd workers rate relationships between frame arguments and knowledge dimensions, selecting from predefined options to establish criteria for annotation.
Only frame/attribute combinations and object pairs with at least 2/3 agreement among workers are retained for annotation, ensuring reliability.
